definitions.explanation: Describes a swift, effortless physical action, often involving jumping or picking something up.
Describes doing something without much thought or appearing somewhere unexpectedly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひょいと⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}び{越|こ}えた→飛び越える：04616_tobikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The cat jumped over the fence with ease.

examples.japanese: ひょいと⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げた→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧。
examples.english: I lifted the luggage up effortlessly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひょいと{水溜|みずたま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}び{越|こ}えた→飛び越える：04616_tobikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The child nimbly jumped over the puddle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひょいと⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
ひょいと⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ひょいと⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}った→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧。
examples.english: I casually stopped by a bookstore during my walk.

notes:
TYPE: Mimetic word (gitaigo/adverb) describing manner of action.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MOVEMENT:
- Emphasizes ease and swiftness
- Often used with jumping, lifting, dodging
- Implies agility or lightness

SENSE 2 - CASUAL/SUDDEN:
- Dropping by casually
- Remembering suddenly
- Doing something without much planning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひょいと⟦{飛|と}び{越|こ}える→飛び越える：04616_tobikoeru⟧ (to jump over easily)
- ひょいと⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧ (to pick up effortlessly)
- ひょいと⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ (to appear suddenly)
- ひょいと⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧ (to take a quick peek)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぴょん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: with a hop (more bouncy)
- さっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: quickly, swiftly (more deliberate)
- ふらっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: casually, aimlessly (for visiting)
- ⟦ひょっこり→ひょっこり：16582_hyokkori⟧: suddenly appearing
